all_rights_reserved.name: All rights reserved
all_rights_reserved.summary: You keep every right. Others can listen on Re-Mixed but can’t reuse your track without asking.

cc_by.summary: Anyone can share, remix and use it, even commercially, as long as they credit you.

cc_by_sa.summary: Like CC BY, but remixes must be shared under the same licence.

cc_by_nc.summary: Anyone can share and remix it with credit, but not to make money.

cc_by_nc_sa.summary: Non-commercial sharing and remixing with credit; remixes use the same licence.

cc_by_nd.summary: Anyone can share it as-is with credit, but no remixes or edits.

cc_by_nc_nd.summary: Share it as-is with credit, non-commercially. No remixes.

cc_zero.summary: You give up your rights: anyone can do anything with it, no credit needed.
